name: grimmsnarl_ml_v7
deck_note: Unchanged from v1-v7: the exact 60-card Grimmsnarl list used by the selected corpus.
model_note: Byte-identical to grimmsnarl_ml_v5 and v6: the same refreshed 2000-tree team-conditioned ranker, 823 features, 4,097 games, 322,975 decisions, 21 teams. v7 changes the teacher routing table, not the weights.
rules_note: fallback_policy.py, ml_planner.py, ml_features.py and policy_base.py are byte-identical to v5, including the v5 Punk Up and Buddy-Buddy Poffin search budgets and all five planner dominance rules.

policy_escalation.code_source: Dense 0..20 code from sorted team ids in corpus_v5_data_refresh_candidate.npz; asserted in tests/test_v6_teacher_escalation.py.
policy_escalation.rationale: The deployed pin 16494330 has the highest Froslass evolve rate of the 21 pilots in the corpus (95.7% of the turns it is offered, against 52.6% in the mirror for 16371703). v5 plays it on 59 of 59 offered turns, so the behaviour is faithful imitation of an outlier rather than a modelling error, and three previous versions failed to move a MAIN preference with feature columns. A MAIN select that offers the Froslass evolve is therefore scored end to end as pilot 16371703; every other decision keeps the pin.
policy_escalation.scope_note: One teacher code per argmax. The pin's answer on the escalated decisions is also computed, purely so the deployed change rate is a counted number in diag_snapshot rather than an assumption.

classes.name: petrel_stamp
classes.evidence: Dead Unfair Stamp take rate is the only measured pilot gap with a significant rating gradient (Spearman rho -0.626, permutation p 0.0029). Team 16561259 takes it on 33.0% of its own 103 dead offers versus 71.3% for the deployed pin. On the corrected teacher-forced 66-game v5 board probe it sees 39 offers, moves 6 decisions and refuses 5 Stamp picks, with one unrelated move.

policy: v6's search budgets, one-ply planner and Froslass class are unchanged. Routed single-pick contexts use the refreshed 2000-tree ranker pinned to 16494330, except a MAIN select offering a Froslass evolve is scored as 16371703 and a Petrel search offering Unfair Stamp is scored as 16561259. Low-support context 8 remains on the rule policy. Multi-pick selects and face-down prize picks remain with the marnies_grimmsnarl_ex_v7 rule policy.

stored_board_validation.mode: escalation-only scoring with every replay action teacher-forced once
stored_board_validation.evaluator_correction: The earlier v6 full probe did not set ranker.teacher_forced and therefore entered candidate then replay actions into intra-turn history. The evaluator now suppresses candidate commits and advances only with the stored action. This changes the v6 Froslass counters from 16/12 to 17/13; v7 exactly matches the corrected v6 result on that inherited class.

imitation_fidelity.metric: Exact raw action-index agreement of the complete v7 runtime under teacher forcing; stricter than semantic Top-1 because an interchangeable duplicate at another index remains a miss.
imitation_fidelity.source: The teacher's 18 per-team chronological held-out games beginning at episode 89418031.
imitation_fidelity.uncertainty_note: The 0.90 gate is met by the held-out point estimate; its decision-level 95% lower bound is 0.8983. The audit artifact is experiments/grimmsnarl_ml_v8_imitation/runtime_v7_teacher16494330.json.
imitation_fidelity.pooled_85_percent_note: The 0.8500 offline figure averages 21 distinct policies while scoring each row with its own teacher code; it is a representation benchmark, not the fidelity of the deployed fixed-teacher runtime.
imitation_fidelity.rejection_note: A dedicated current-top-teacher ranker scored 0.8311, an offered-set next-action reranker scored 0.8417 (no test gain), and a fresh current-top-four ranker scored 0.8222 pooled. None was eligible to replace the verified runtime.

versus_v6.note: Safety/large-regression screen only; 20 mirror games cannot resolve this narrow class change. The two arenas ran concurrently, so timing is comparable within this match only.

versus_a7ee2991_sparring_panel.interpretation: Not outcome evidence: the opponent model has only 56.65% non-forced semantic agreement on its chronological 20-game test. It is retained as a board-generation and safety instrument.

description: v7 is the single-variable successor to v6: it retains the Froslass class and enables the pre-registered Petrel-to-dead-Unfair-Stamp class with a separate measured teacher. The deck, model, features, fallback policy and planner are unchanged. A local Mega Lopunny ex / Mega Froslass ex sparring agent was also built from 106 opponent-seat replays, but its 56.6% unseen semantic agreement is below the gate for using its win rate to justify a matchup-specific production rule.
